ext:name: How we are doing
ext:hint: The few headline figures, on the front page rather than behind an administration screen: these are what the institution is asked to report on, and everyone doing the work has a stake in them. Ordered above the working grids because it is a summary - a reader who has to scroll past two full-height tables to reach it will not read it. Which figures appear is decided by the metric definitions' own order, so putting one on the front page is editing a node.
